overview_description: List and read countries, and update a country's status, description and default address fields.
intro: Countries are the settings records an address or a warehouse refers to. You can list them, read one, and update a country's status, description or default address fields. This area has 3 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
warning: **Known issue: an update returns the country's values from before the change.** Read the country again to see what is stored.
notes: **A country `id` starts with `country_`.** Other records, such as a warehouse, refer to a country by this `id`.
**A country's `name` holds its two letter code.** For example `AU` for Australia.
**The listing pages by cursor with the `cursor` parameter.** `starting_after` is ignored and returns the first page again.
**An update accepts `status`, `description` and the `default_*` fields.** Send them under `country`.

endpoints.title: List countries
endpoints.summary: Returns a page of countries under `data`, with paging details under `pagination`.
endpoints.description: Lists the countries on the instance. A country's `name` holds its two letter code, such as `AU`. Pass `limit` to set the page size, and while `pagination.has_more` is true pass `pagination.next_cursor` back as `cursor` to read the next page. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`, and `sort` orders the results. `starting_after` is ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the next one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a country
endpoints.summary: Returns one country by its `country_` `id`, under `country`.

parameters.name: country_id
parameters.description: The country's `country_` `id`, as the listing returns it.

endpoints.title: Update a country
endpoints.summary: Changes a country's status, description or default address fields.
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change under `country`. You can change `status`, `description` and the `default_*` fields such as `default_state` and `default_city`. The response holds the country's values from before the change, so read the country again to see what is stored.

parameters.name: country_id
parameters.description: The country's `country_` `id`, as the listing returns it.

200.description: The country's values from before the change, under `country`.

limit.description: The page size applied to this page.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Trust this over `next_cursor`, which can still be set on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Pass this back as `cursor` to read the next page.
